import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' for clarity in visualization
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Define a logical order for BMI categories for better plotting
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization Setup ---
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 15))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Sleep Health and Lifestyle Factors', fontsize=22, weight='bold', y=1.02)

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level, detailed by other factors ---
# This plot shows the core relationship between stress and sleep quality,
# while encoding gender, sleep disorder, and activity level for deeper insights.
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    style='Gender',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(40, 250),
    palette='magma',
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=axes[0, 0]
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Factors', loc='center left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 0.5))
axes[0, 0].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# --- Plot 2: Sleep Duration by Occupation ---
# A violin plot to show the distribution of sleep duration for different occupations,
# highlighting potential lifestyle differences.
# We focus on the most frequent occupations for clarity.
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().nlargest(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]

sns.violinplot(
    data=df_top_occ,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Occupation',
    order=top_occupations,
    inner='quartile',
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette='crest',
    cut=0
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation (Top 6)', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2)


# --- Plot 3: Sleep Disorder Prevalence by BMI Category and Gender ---
# A dodged bar plot to compare the prevalence of sleep disorders across
# BMI categories, with a breakdown by gender.
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    palette='plasma'
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence by BMI Category', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Individuals', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
for p in axes[1, 0].patches:
    if p.get_height() > 0:
        axes[1, 0].annotate(f'{int(p.get_height())}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='black', xytext=(0, 5),
                         textcoords='offset points')

# --- Plot 4: Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality ---
# A joint plot showing both the relationship and individual distributions
# of sleep duration and quality, colored by the presence of a sleep disorder.
g = sns.jointplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    kind='kde',
    fill=True,
    palette='viridis',
    ax=axes[1, 1]
)
# This is a bit of a hack to place a jointplot onto a subplot axis
# We hide the original axis and use the jointplot's figure space.
# For a simpler approach, a standard scatter/kde would also work.
# Here we'll replace it with a more compatible plot type for subplots.

sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    fill=True,
    alpha=0.6,
    palette='viridis',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    legend=True
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality Density', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# --- Final Adjustments ---
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.9, 1]) # Adjust layout to make room for suptitle and legend

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
